mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and cardiac stimulation while quinidine prolongs QT interval and has negative inotropic effects, creating opposing cardiac effects and risk of arrhythmia; quinidine may inhibit amphetamine metabolism via CYP2D6.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective amphetamine dose, monitor cardiac rhythm with ECG, and assess for arrhythmia symptoms; consider alternative ADHD medications.
